title: Adaptive onboarding checklist and multi-variant smoke suite for OSS LLMs
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: Goal: implement an adaptive, reproducible end-to-end onboarding checklist and an automated multi-variant smoke test suite for incoming open-source LLM weights. This ticket covers: (1) a concise canonical checklist that gate-keeps conversion, metric collection, and pin suggestion; (2) a param-driven smoke suite that runs a small but representative set of generation, embedding, and KV-cache tests across quantization variants; (3) automated flags for non-deterministic conversion, license incompatibility, or runtime mismatches; (4) publishing of a first-pass performance profile (latency, p95, tokens/sec, memory footprint) to the model catalog with provenance links. Deliverables: checklist as markdown in docs repo, a smoke-suite workflow (GitHub Actions + internal orchestrator), conversion sanity harness that compares raw logits and sample outputs across CPU/GPU backends, and automated profile publish task that writes a draft profile to the profile-store for manual review. Success criteria: onboarding runs without manual intervention for >80% of community weights (excluding known exotic architectures), smoke-suite catches regressions introduced by conversion >90% of the time in synthetic fault-injection tests, and published profile contains minimum fields required by catalog schema (model_id, pin_candidate, float/quant variants, p50/p95 tokens/ms, memory_estimate, provenance_url).
comments: 2026-02-20 - Aisha Khatri: Created ticket. Initial scope drafted after sync with PM and Runtime leads. We want a pragmatic checklist that prevents obvious bad pins from reaching the catalog.

2026-02-25 - Miguel Ortega: Spike completed for conversion determinism. Found non-deterministic layer-norm order in one community checkpoint that produced 1-2 token differences in greedy decode. Added deterministic-seed and tolerance threshold into the harness.

2026-03-01 - Priya Shah (PM): Requested that output-quality checks include a tiny eval set (10 prompts) for top-k/top-p sampling and coherent scoring. Also asked for a clear rollback path if published profile fails later QA.

2026-03-03 - Miguel Ortega: Implemented multi-variant smoke matrix. Tests run across fp16, int8-quant, and int4-ggml-style variants. Observed int4 variant reduced memory by ~60% but increased p95 by ~28% on A10 GPU. Documented trade-offs in the checklist.

2026-03-05 - Design review (Lina Chen): Request to surface the pin confidence as a three-state badge (Recommended / Review Required / Not Recommended) with tooltip explaining checks that failed. Added to UI pre-publish notes.

2026-03-07 - Security (Evan Brooks): License scan false-positive on model with custom minor-license. Blocker: legal needs to confirm permissiveness. Added license_report_url to provenance metadata so reviewers can quickly triage.

2026-03-09 - Miguel Ortega: Added synthetic fault injection to smoke-suite: corrupt one layer weight blob and verify that conversion pipeline flags checksum mismatch and does not auto-publish. Smoke-suite detected checksum mismatch 100% of runs during tests.

2026-03-11 - QA (Rina Gupta): Running end-to-end runs against three community models. Found a throughput regression when sequence length > 2048 for a particular transformer variant; added a measurement threshold and a warning to profile publish if throughput drops >40% relative to similar-sized models.

2026-03-12 - Miguel Ortega: Draft profile auto-publish now writes to staging catalog and opens PR in docs repo with the checklist and reported metrics. Next up: add canary rollout for a small percentage of traffic and automatic rollback hook.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical checklist committed as docs (docs/onboarding/checklist.md) and referenced by the intake orchestrator
Smoke-suite workflow executes in CI and internal orchestrator; matrix covers float16/int8/int4 and CPU/GPU backends
Conversion determinism harness compares logits for deterministic ops and falls back to fuzzy-sample-delta for sampling ops
Profile publish writes required fields to profile-store and marks candidate pin with a confidence badge
License and checksum issues surface as blockers and prevent auto-publish
Rollout playbook stub exists for canary and full publish with rollback steps
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-eager auto-publish could expose low-quality pins. Mitigation: default to 'Review Required' for first 2 months for any community model and require manual sign-off for public catalog entries.

Risk: False positives in deterministic checks due to differences in kernel implementations. Mitigation: add tolerance thresholds and compare output distributions rather than exact token sequences for sampling-based tests.
Risk: License ambiguity delaying publish. Mitigation: attach license_report_url and a lightweight legal review flow (2 business days SLA) before profile moves to public catalog.
Risk: Smoke tests add CI runtime cost. Mitigation: keep smoke-suite short (target < 15 minutes) and run full validation asynchronously on a scheduled fleet job for heavy checks.
Risk: Profiling variance across hardware. Mitigation: normalize metrics by platform baseline (e.g., A100 baseline) and publish normalized numbers in addition to raw measurements.
